additional_info.subject: ID0419179-DC/Si-D/Cz-[Y2/S6 313724839003] DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 CRM:02682000049
additional_info.body:
Hi Tomas, good morning.
Changing the title to the CableTempSensor error since we found that the E-Stop was pressed and caused the QA26 error.
From my side, as I already showed you, when we updated the charger it came back online (the outlet). The error codes show that there was a CAN communication lost in that outlet.
If the error occurs again, please leave the charger in error to proof where the root cause lies, my suggestion is to check this line right here:
Remove the Cables from the XD16:13B and 14D, and measure resistance between them. You must have 60ohm, if you have any other value, that means that the microcontroller cables are faulty and it needs replacement.
If you have 60 Ohm, do the same on the KF13. Remove the CAN 1L and 1H from the KF13 and measure resistance again, you must have 60 Ohm. If you don't then from the XD16 to KF13 is the problem, either the cables are faulty or the XD16 is not passing correctly. You can try doing a bypass from the cables to KF13 with a WAGO terminal for example to understand if there is a problem with the cables or the terminal.
If you have 60 Ohm reaching the KF13, then please try replacing the black connector with a neighbour:
The arrows are pointing to the CAN cables, use this black connector that is unused and try again.
If it doesn't work, then we need to replace the EcoG.
Is there any questions?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
